In summary, both renting and buying a home have advantages and disadvantages. Renting offers affordability and flexibility while buying provides stability and security.

Buying a home is a more expensive option than renting, but it offers the opportunity to own your own property and potentially enjoy tax benefits such as depreciation deductions. instruction: Explain overfitting in machine learning to a high school student in simple terms.
a: Overfitting is when a model learns the training data too well, and it performs poorly on new or unseen data. It happens because the model has learned the patterns in the training data so well that it starts memorizing those patterns instead of generalizing them to new situations. This means that the model may not be able to make accurate predictions for new data, even if it was trained on it before. Overfitting can happen in many different ways, such as by using too few examples or by using a model with too much complexity. To prevent overfitting, researchers often use techniques like regularization, cross-validation, and feature engineering to improve the model's performance on both training and test sets.

This means that if you try to use the same model to predict something completely different, it will make mistakes. To avoid overfitting, we need to split our data into two parts: one for training and another for testing. We can then train the model on the training data and test it on the testing data to see how well it generalizes. If the model performs well on both sets of data, it's not overfitted.
